title: Photos | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Picture your wedding at Hio Ridge in Bridgton, Maine. Explore photographs of our barn and getting ready rooms, the ceremony field and the patio.
heading: From the dressing room *to the evening lights.*
lede: See the rooms where you'll get ready and the tables beneath the barn beams. Then look outside to the ceremony field and patio. These photographs show our spaces and gatherings at the farm. Our event season runs from May through October.
